notes.title: Hotfix 1: Save/Load Fixed, Blueprint Persistence, and UI Improvements
notes.content:
🟦 Explanation:
🛠️ Hotfix Deployed!

Thanks for your patience, Commanders! We've just pushed the first hotfix following launch, and it addresses some of the most critical issues:

✅ Save & Load System Fixed
The save/load system is now fully functional.

Your progress, structures, and gameplay state will persist correctly between sessions.

🛠 Blueprint & Ship Spawning Fixes
Fixed an issue where spaceships were not spawning correctly after loading a save.

All blueprint data now persists through save/load, ensuring consistent production and shipbuilding logic.

🖼 UI Preview Improvements
Removed placeholder ship images from the UI previews.

Replaced them with clear category icons for faster recognition and better readability.

notes.title: Update on Demo Performance: Major Issues Resolved
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Thank you for your continued support and invaluable feedback on our demo. We’re excited to share that the major performance issues you experienced have been resolved. While you may still encounter a few minor bugs, please know that these are not affecting the overall gameplay, and our team is working on smoothing them out.

Your feedback has been essential in guiding these improvements, and we appreciate your patience as we continue to refine the experience. We'll keep you updated on further enhancements as they become available.

Thank you for your support.

Best regards,
Flying Hound Studio

notes.title: Demo Update: Technical Issues
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Thank you for testing our demo and sharing your feedback. We understand that some of you are experiencing issues such as lag and unresponsiveness. Our team is actively investigating these problems to improve your experience.

Unfortunately, we've encountered an unexpected challenge with our build deployment process. A recent update in our infrastructure has revealed some compatibility issues that we need to address before rolling out an update. Because of these unforeseen technical difficulties, we must delay the release of the updated demo until February 27th.

We sincerely appreciate your patience and support while we work through these issues. Your feedback is invaluable, and we remain committed to delivering a smoother, more enjoyable experience.

Thank you for your understanding.

Best regards,
Flying Hound Studio
